page: Microsoft Azure DC96es_v6 is a virtual machine instance belonging to the DCEV6 server family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 CPU architecture. The instance is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory allocation of 4.0 GB per core. This instance does not include any local storage, but it is designated as Premium Storage capable, allowing for external block storage attachments. There are no onboard GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this configuration.

From a resource density perspective, the DC96es_v6 offers a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, aligning it with general-purpose and memory-optimized workloads that require high-core counts without extreme memory-per-core demands. The lack of local storage represents a key architectural tradeoff, requiring users to provision external storage volumes separately, which can impact overall cost efficiency depending on the storage tier selected. This instance is suited for enterprise applications, large-scale web serving, database management systems utilizing external storage, and general-purpose business-critical workloads that benefit from dedicated CPU allocation.
